CONTEXT.content: Architecture docs explain why the system looks the way it does. ADRs capture decisions; diagrams show structure; both decay without maintenance.
CONTEXT.analogy: Blueprints plus change orders — without them, every renovation is guesswork.
CONTEXT.productionNote: New hires and future-you depend on docs written today.
hints: Document decisions, not just current state.

DECIDE.optionA: C4 model diagrams: context → container → component.
DECIDE.optionB: Narrative doc with one sequence diagram for the critical path.

tradeoffs.B: Fast to write; may miss boundaries as system grows.

hints: What does your next teammate need on day 1?

BUILD.goal: Write an ADR for one architectural decision in your app. Include context, decision, consequences, and alternatives rejected.

tracks.general: Document auth choice, database choice, or API style.

acceptance: ADR follows: Status, Context, Decision, Consequences
Diagram or ASCII sketch of affected components
hints: Consequences include negative tradeoffs you accepted.
Link ADR from README or docs folder.

criteria: Reader unfamiliar with project understands the decision
hints: Ask a peer: can you find the auth flow from this doc alone?

BREAK.scenario: Code refactored to microservices but docs still show monolith diagram.
BREAK.symptoms: Onboarding confusion. Wrong assumptions in incident response.
hints: When should docs update — with the PR or after?
Add doc update to PR checklist.

FIX.goal: Update diagram and ADR status. Add 'docs updated' to PR template.
hints: Stale docs are worse than none — they lie confidently.

decisionCallbacks.A: C4 structure gave clear places to update when architecture changed.
decisionCallbacks.B: Narrative was faster to write but harder to patch incrementally after the refactor.
